definitions.explanation: The quality of being passed down through genes from parent to offspring. Used in medical, scientific, and everyday contexts when discussing traits or conditions that run in families.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{遺伝性|いでんせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This disease has a hereditary nature.

examples.japanese: {遺伝性|いでんせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{疾患|しっかん}→疾患：16370_shikkan⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}した→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧。
examples.english: I consulted a doctor about hereditary disorders.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{病歴|びょうれき}→病歴：19429_byoureki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{遺伝性|いでんせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦リスク→リスク：06752_risuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It is important to examine hereditary risk from family medical history.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{遺伝|いでん}→遺伝：10137_iden⟧ (heredity, genetics) and ⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧ (nature, quality). Functions as a noun and also as a modifier before other nouns using the ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ particle. Frequently appears in medical and scientific contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遺伝性|いでんせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧: hereditary disease
- {遺伝性|いでんせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{疾患|しっかん}→疾患：16370_shikkan⟧: hereditary disorder
- {遺伝性|いでんせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have a hereditary nature
- {遺伝性|いでんせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: to be highly hereditary

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{遺伝|いでん}→遺伝：10137_iden⟧: heredity — the broader concept of genetic inheritance
- {先天性|せんてんせい}: congenital — present from birth, but not necessarily inherited
- {家族性|かぞくせい}: familial — running in families, which may include both genetic and environmental factors
